About these terms

These terms apply to the use of Dukan ERP, developed and operated by [TEST] Registered legal name (TSX-MR). By applying for or using a business account, the business accepts them. Pending decision: legal_review

The service

Dukan ERP is offered to businesses only. It consists of a mobile app used by the business’s owner and staff, and of a business account on this website where the subscription is managed. Each store runs the retail and electronics activity, the money-services agent activity, or both, as its subscription allows.

Business accounts

  • The owner applies for the business. TSX-MR reviews each application and may refuse it; nothing is activated before approval.
  • The owner is responsible for the staff accounts of the business and for the permissions given to each person.
  • Each person keeps their password and verification codes to themselves and gives accurate contact details.

Subscriptions

  • Each store has a monthly subscription for its activity, with staff seats included; additional seats are charged per store. The current prices are shown on the Dukan ERP page and confirmed in the business account.
  • There is no free trial.
  • A store or a seat added during a month is charged for that month. A removal, or a change to a lower-priced activity, takes effect at the next renewal.
  • A change to a higher-priced activity is charged for the difference when it is confirmed.

Payments

Payments are made as agreed with TSX-MR, which confirms each one against the payment’s reference. No payment is taken in the mobile app or on this website.

Grace period, read-only access and suspension

When a paid period ends, the app keeps working for 72 hours. After that it becomes read-only — records can still be read and exported — until the next period is confirmed.

TSX-MR may suspend a business, with a recorded reason.

Acceptable use

  • Use Dukan ERP only for the business’s lawful operations.
  • Do not try to reach another business’s information or to disrupt the service.
  • Record accurate information.

The business’s information

The business is responsible for the information it records about its customers, suppliers and staff. Personal information is handled as described in the privacy policy.

Mobile-money providers

Dukan ERP records the exchanges that the business’s team enters. It is not connected to any mobile-money provider and does not check a provider’s balance; no provider has approved or endorsed it.

Availability and liability

Pending decision: liability

Closing an account

An account is closed by deleting it in the app. When the last owner deletes their account, the business is closed and its subscription cancelled, as described on the account deletion page.

Governing law

Pending decision: governing_law
